faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.asideLink: Send a request — we’ll clarify everything in the chat

items.a: You send the VIN and describe the part. We check catalogues and supplier stock, then send you options with price and delivery time via your preferred messenger.

items.q: Can you find a part by VIN?
items.a: Yes, that’s our main method. The VIN shows the exact configuration of the car, so the risk of a mismatch is minimal. No VIN at hand? Enter make, model and year in the request — our manager will ask for the VIN or a registration photo in the chat.

items.q: Can I order an OEM part?
items.a: Yes. If the original part is available from our suppliers, we’ll offer it with price and delivery time.
Yes. We usually offer several options: OEM and cheaper aftermarket parts. The choice is yours.

items.q: Can I order a used part?
items.a: Yes, if a suitable one is available. We’ll describe its condition honestly before you pay.
It depends on where the part is found: in Batumi — today or tomorrow, from Turkey — usually 1–3 days, from the UAE — 5–10 days. We confirm the exact time before you pay.
Only after you’ve approved the option, the price and the delivery time. Until then, you pay nothing.

items.q: What if the part doesn’t fit?
items.a: If it doesn’t fit because we got the VIN match wrong, we’ll replace it or refund you. In other cases, return terms depend on the supplier — we’ll tell you upfront.
